d: Maharashtra's Food and Drug Administration (FDA), led by Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe, has suspended the licences of 105 food businesses following a special inspection drive on November 4 and 5 ahead of Diwali. Blinkit, Zepto, Biryani By Kilo, Tossin Pizza and Jumbo Burger were among the businesses facing action. The FDA also ordered seven establishments to shut down and seized 39,485 kg of food articles worth over Rs 1.35 crore. Inspections revealed unhygienic conditions, improper food handling and packaging, inadequate pest control and missing safety records. Three FIRs were registered…
